subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this umbrella remain open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89739 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90194 settle the cadence and retention slices, or should maintainers split the remaining context-warning/session-cleanup work now?
rationale: The source-backed gaps are real, but the cadence floor is a new core config/product contract and the retention fix changes persisted cron session cleanup semantics.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Through Linked PRs
options.body: Use this issue as the canonical umbrella while maintainers review the default-off cadence guardrail and guarded retention cleanup, then split only leftover work.

options.title: Split Remaining Guardrails Now
options.body: Create narrower canonical issues for context threshold warnings and general sessions-cleanup behavior while leaving the two open PRs to own their specific slices.

options.title: Reject Core Cadence Guardrail
options.body: If maintainers do not want a core cron cadence knob, close or narrow that PR and keep only the retention/session cleanup bug path open.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Through Linked PRs
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the canonical umbrella while maintainers review the default-off cadence guardrail and guarded retention cleanup, then split only leftover work.

likelyOwner.reason: amknight authored the active configurable cadence guardrail PR and posted the supersession decision for the warning-only direction.
